model: Mini Cryogen-Free Magnet System (m-CFMS) for QHR
family: desk-top cryogen-free magnet + VTI system for graphene quantum Hall resistance measurements
description: Miniature dry desk-top cryostat (900 x 660 x 440 mm) with pulse-tube cryocooler, 5-9 T superconducting magnet and integrated VTI (25 or 30 mm sample space, 1.6-400 K), offered by Cryogenic Ltd as its miniature cryogen-free QHR system for graphene; optional He-3 insert (325 mK) and VTI-base optical access.

configurations.name: m-CFMS 5 T, 30 mm VTI, with DC resistivity/Hall (electrical transport) probe
configurations.configuration_basis: m-CFMS with the 5 T magnet option and 30 mm VTI plus the DC Resistivity and Hall Effect module; He-3 insert and VTI-base optical access NOT fitted. m-CFMS values from the Cryogenic QHR brochure flyer; VTI gas flow, optical option and transport module from the CFMS brochure v5.2 (same integrated VTI platform). The 2020 CFMS brochure lists Mini CFMS fields of 3-7 T, so the 5 T option (common to both documents) is used.

unknowns.why: The absence is inferred from 'continuous gas flow in VTI'. The VTI is pumped to reach 1.6 K, and the same brochure describes CFMS probes with the sample in vacuum or an IVC. No explicit statement that the sample space cannot be evacuated.
Tied to the rejected vacuum absence.

Key mismatch. data/capability_vocabulary.json defines module.electrical_transport as the 'AC electrical transport option installed'. This configuration has the DC Resistivity/Hall module only; the AC option (micro-coax probe, Keithley source, Zurich lock-in) is a separate option the configuration does not include.
